Why SENTRON measuring devices?

Energy savings start with a solid foundation of reproducible power values. Across all levels of low-voltage distribution, our portfolio enables you to optimize operations and build smart energy management setups. Whether in infrastructure, building management, manufacturing, EV charging, or renewables, these devices integrate seamlessly into your automation environment. By doing so, they help you meet strict regulatory standards and drive your long-term sustainability initiatives forward.
heading: Why SENTRON measuring devices?

text: Key benefits
Gain full transparency of energy consumption

Monitor energy, power quality, and system conditions across all levels of your installation. SENTRON devices deliver precise, reproducible data for informed decisions and targeted efficiency improvements.
heading: Gain full transparency of energy consumption

text: Improve efficiency and reduce energy costs

Identify energy waste, peak loads, and inefficiencies early. With detailed consumption data, you can optimize operations, allocate costs accurately, and support energy management standards such as ISO 50001.
heading: Improve efficiency and reduce energy costs

text: Build a future-ready, scalable energy monitoring setup

Choose from a comprehensive portfolio covering DIN rail to front-panel devices, Modbus to PROFINET connectivity, MID-certified options. SENTRON integrates seamlessly with software solutions, growing with your application.
heading: Build a future-ready, scalable energy monitoring setup

text: Choose the optimal SENTRON measuring device

From basic energy meters to advanced multifunction devices: Find the optimal SENTRON measuring solution for every stage of your plant. Enable reliable data, seamless communication, and efficient power monitoring from the start.

text: Frequently asked questions
What is low-voltage condition monitoring with SENTRON and how does it enhance energy monitoring?

Low-voltage condition monitoring with SENTRON is a digital ecosystem that extends the value of SENTRON measuring devices by transforming collected measurement data into actionable insights – enabling timely maintenance before failures occur, without replacing functional components too early.
heading: What is low-voltage condition monitoring with SENTRON and how does it enhance energy monitoring?

text: Whether used for an entry-level monitoring setup or advanced energy management, SENTRON low-voltage condition monitoring helps organizations operate electrical systems more efficiently, sustainably, and securely.
heading: What is low-voltage condition monitoring with SENTRON and how does it enhance energy monitoring?

heading: What is low-voltage condition monitoring with SENTRON and how does it enhance energy monitoring?

text: What is SENTRON Powerconfig and what is it used for?

SENTRON Powerconfig is a PC-based commissioning software designed for communication-capable devices within the SENTRON portfolio. It simplifies device setup and significantly reduces configuration time, especially when multiple devices must be parameterized.
